subject: CloudNova QBR & roadmap demo — exec slot conflict and slot-trade proposal
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@cloudnova.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: CloudNova Procurement <procure@cloudnova.com>
Date: 2028-09-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: CloudNova QBR & roadmap demo - need to shift exec slot

Hi Connor / Ben,

Quick heads-up — our CTO just got pulled into a product issue for Sep 12 and can’t make the 9:00–9:45 PT executive walkthrough you proposed for our renewal QBR. We still want the full roadmap demo next week, but need to move the exec portion.

Two options from our side that would work:
- Wed Sep 13, 09:00–10:00 PT (CTO + Head of ML available)
- Thu Sep 14, 13:00–13:45 PT (CTO joins at the top of the hour, then needs to drop)

Can your team do either? If neither, we can attempt a slot trade (swap the exec walkthrough with a later internal workshop) — happy to coordinate.

Attendees: Samantha Lee (CTO office), Daniel Park (Head of ML), procurement (procure@cloudnova.com).

Attached: CloudNova_QBR_agenda_v3.pdf — last version from our side. Also linking our renewal record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/4321

Thanks,
Samantha

--
Samantha Lee
VP Product & Strategy | CloudNova
Samantha.lee@cloudnova.com | +1 415-555-0192
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@cloudnova.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-09-10T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CloudNova QBR & roadmap demo - need to shift exec slot

Thanks for the note, Samantha — appreciate the heads-up. Sorry to hear about the conflict.

We can do a slot-trade approach and keep the overall day intact so your execs only need the shorter walkthrough window. Proposed plan:

1) Exec walkthrough (concise): Thu Sep 14, 13:00–13:30 PT — Connor + Marissa lead a 30-min exec-focused narrative (high-level outcomes, SLA/commitment items, TCO).
2) Technical workshop / hands-on demo: Thu Sep 14, 14:00–15:00 PT — Ben + Tessa run deep dive and live Q&A (longer, interactive).
3) Fallback: Wed Sep 13, 09:00–10:00 PT — we keep this open if you prefer that day.

Action items for us (we’ll dispatch):
- Draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) reflecting the split executive vs technical agenda — attached as mutual_action_plan_draft.docx.
- Marissa: confirm exec-level slides + 5-min opening for product roadmap.
- Tessa: prepare runbook for the live demo and recording; include a short checklist for connectivity and data sampling.

Marissa — can you confirm the 13:00–13:30 PT exec slot is feasible from your side? If so I’ll send revised invites and mark the 14:00 deep-dive as a separate invite with a join link for the engineers.

If CloudNova prefers Wed 9–10 instead, we can flip, but the split-day approach gives execs the short focused slot they asked for.

Cheers,
Connor

Subject: Re: CloudNova QBR & roadmap demo - exec slot conflict and slot-trade proposal

Connor — I’m good with the split approach. Confirming: Thu Sep 14, 13:00–13:30 PT for the exec walkthrough. I’ll own a tight 15-min slide deck + 10-min Q&A; would like to limit slides to top 3 ROI items.

Two quick asks for CloudNova:
- Can you confirm if the CTO needs any procurement / licensing numbers during the exec slot? If yes, we’ll have Ben drop a single slide.
- We’ll record the session; do you need the recording restricted or deleted after the QBR?

Connor — please go ahead and send the updated invites. I’ll finish the executive slides today and share a PDF.

Thanks,
Marissa

- Thu Sep 14, 13:00–13:30 PT — CloudNova Executive Walkthrough (Teams link)

Attachments: cloudnova_qbr_invite.ics (calendar stub). I added the recording consent text in the invite and set the recording to be internal-only by default. If CloudNova wants different retention, reply and I’ll update.
